patthana18.2:1.1: hetuṃ hetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetusampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.2:3.1: hetuṃ hetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetuvippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.2:4.1: na hetuṃ hetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na hetuvippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
